name: lyr
description: Lyr (.lyr) language support: syntax highlighting, and Go and TypeScript completion, diagnostics and rename through lyr lsp.

lyr.path.markdownDescription: The `lyr` binary the extension runs (`lyr lsp`, `lyr generate`, `lyr doctor`). A bare name is looked up on `PATH`; a relative path is resolved against the first workspace folder; `~/` is your home directory.

lyr.goplsPath.markdownDescription: The gopls that `lyr lsp` starts, passed as its `goplsPath` initialization option. Empty: `gopls` on `PATH`, then `go tool gopls` if your `go.mod` pins it.

lyr.typescriptPath.markdownDescription: The TypeScript 7 (7.0.2 or later) that `lyr lsp` starts for `<script>` blocks, passed as its `typescriptPath` initialization option: a native `tsc` binary or a `typescript` package directory. Empty: the project's `node_modules/typescript`, then `tsc` on `PATH`, then `bun x --package typescript@7.0.2` when Bun is installed.

scripts.test: bun check --no-script && vscode-tmgrammar-snap --config package.json 'test/*.lyr' && bun run test:markdown
scripts.test:update: vscode-tmgrammar-snap --config package.json --updateSnapshot 'test/*.lyr' && vscode-tmgrammar-snap --config package.json -g test/grammars/markdown.tmLanguage.json -s text.html.markdown --updateSnapshot 'test/*.md'
scripts.package: bun run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out lyr-$npm_package_version.vsix
scripts.publish: vsce publish --no-dependencies --packagePath lyr-$npm_package_version.vsix && ovsx publish lyr-$npm_package_version.vsix
